description:
Requirements:

  • University degree / equivalent technical qualification;
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in indirect materials procurement;
  • Knowledge of international trade procedures;
  • Knowledge about supplier markets for packaging, abrasive, polishing materials and commercial contracts;
  • Technical knowledge of manufacturing processes and industrial materials;
  • High negotiation skills / cost validation  (e.g. packaging calculation);
  • Proficiency in English.

Social Competencies:

  • Ability to collaborate and work effectively across diverse cultural environments;
  • Ability to adapt efficiently to changing circumstances and new challenges;
  • Ability to communicate clearly and effectively;
  • Confident presentation and public speaking skills;
  • Excellent time management and prioritization skills;
  • Results-driven mindset with a strong focus on achieving objectives.

Main responsibilities:

  • Develops and maintains supplier panel for packaging, polishing, abrasive for the plants;
  • Supports Logistics planning by calculating and quoting customer packaging;
  • Collaborates closely with JQ teams across Europe, North America and China;
  • Executes yearly price negotiations;
  • Manages complaints at the escalation level;
  • Coordinates internal and external project nominations, including packaging, in line with project timelines and budget requirements;
  • Delivers annual cost savings in line with company objectives;
  • Monitors and reports key performance indicators;
  • Identifies, evaluates, and recommends reliable suppliers of goods;

 About us 

JOYSONQUIN Automotive Systems Romania produces steering wheels and ornamental elements for the dashboard, doors and center console, based on a modern technology and the diversity of materials used: noble veneer, leather, carbon and plastic. For over 20 years we have been satisfying the needs of our clients, renowned car manufacturers, such as Mercedes, Bentley, Audi, BMW, Porsche and Volkswagen. The quality of the products and the trust that our customers give us are the result of the professionalism of our employees. The company has 1000 employees in Ghimbav, Romania and is constantly developing.
